description: A Python script to run multinode training with submitit, including argument parsing, shared folder setup, checkpoint handling, and job submission.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: A class to handle training setup, checkpointing, and execution for multinode training.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, extending detection's argument parser.

methods.name: get_shared_folder
methods.description: Returns a shared folder Path based on environment, raising error if unavailable.

methods.name: get_init_file
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique init file path for distributed training.

methods.name: Trainer.__call__
methods.description: Runs detection.main with the stored arguments.

methods.name: Trainer.checkpoint
methods.description: Prepares a checkpoint for requeuing the training job.

methods.name: Trainer._setup_gpu_args
methods.description: Sets up GPU-related arguments based on the job environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up the executor, configure parameters, and submit the training job.
